verdict.rationale: Tracking whether and when recipients opened an email is a fair capability to ask of an email client, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents read receipts or open tracking. Mentions of read status (IMAP unread-count sync) concern the user's own mailbox, not recipient opens, and add-on or API building blocks are not the capability itself.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can see whether and when recipients opened my email
